title: Efficacy and Safety of HL-040XC in Essential Hypertension and Hyperlipidemia
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate efficacy and safety of HL-040XC in patients with essential hypertension and hyperlipidemia
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Aged between 18 and 80 years
* History of essential hypertension and hyperlipidemia
* Able to sign informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* At screening, SBP ≥ 180mmHg or DBP ≥ 110mmHg or LDL-C \> 250mg/dL or TG ≥ 400mg/dL
* Has a history of hypersensitivity to Angiotensin Ⅱ receptor blocker or HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor or component of this drug
